title: JANUS owner NAS SQLite WAL recovery copies — metadata only, no private row extraction

scope.reason: At least three WAL files exceed 1.2GB; reading whole WAL would impose avoidable NAS I/O.

code_preflight.guarantees: Detects basic SQLite and WAL header structure, page-size agreement and complete frame layout without reading rows.
code_preflight.does_not_guarantee: Checksum validity, transaction consistency, recoverability, safe automatic restore or private data integrity.

restoration_gates: Never treat archived SHM as authoritative or replace a live SQLite DB using byte copies alone.
Validate WAL/DB pairing on a private, consistent immutable copy; handle SQLite WAL checkpoint semantics in a disposable local environment.
Do not execute the historical db_guard that defaults full restoration enabled on QNAP.
Do not publish raw private memories, chat_history, key vaults or DB rows in GitHub.
Only consider repair after backup verification, rollback plan and explicit owner approval.
